exec: let result=[];requests.forEach((request,index)=>pm.sendRequest(request,(err,res)=>{pm.test('Carrera sin error transporte '+index,()=>pm.expect(err).to.equal(null));if(err)return;result[index]=res.code;if(result.filter(x=>x!==undefined).length===2){pm.collectionVariables.set('rvCarreraCodigos',JSON.stringify(result));pm.test('Carrera mantiene una sola operacion compatible',()=>pm.expect(JSON.stringify(result)).to.be.oneOf(['[201,400]','[400,200]']));}}));

const reservas=pm.response.json().reservas.filter(r=>r.mesaId===Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('rvCarreraMesaId'))&&['PENDIENTE','CONFIRMADA'].includes(r.estado));pm.test('No hay reserva bloqueante en mesa inactiva',()=>{if(pm.collectionVariables.get('rvCarreraActivo')===false)pm.expect(reservas).to.have.lengthOf(0);else pm.expect(reservas).to.have.lengthOf(1);});
